As a Supervisory IT Specialist (INFOSEC), you will perform the following duties: Oversee the procurement, development, integration, modification, operation, maintenance, and disposal of a Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) system in accordance with National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-12.

Conduct system security evaluation and ensure the rigorous application of information security and information assurance policies, principles, and practices in the delivery of all Information Technology (IT) services.

Conduct risk and vulnerability assessment of planned and installed information systems to identify vulnerabilities, risks, and protection needs. Apply the Risk Management Framework (RMF) as it applies to Federal Information Systems and analyze and determine the Risk Mitigation process.

Perform a full range of supervisory functions, including developing and evaluating performance standards, giving advice, counsel, or instruction to employees. Make or approve selections for subordinate positions and identify training needs.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS: Applicants must possess the following two certifications: A current Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), also known as (ISC)2, AND a Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Certified Incident Handler (GCIH).

Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) is an independent information security certification granted by the International Information System Security Certification Consortium, also known as (ISC)2 Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) The GIAC Incident Handler certification validates a practitioner's ability to detect, respond, and resolve computer security incidents using a wide range of essential security skills.

GCIH certification holders have the knowledge needed to manage security incidents by understanding common attack techniques, vectors and tools, as well as defend against and respond to such attacks when they occur. Incumbent must have a current or past System Owner designation of a Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) system.

We are seeking a senior technical leader to spearhead the transformation of our software release and change management practices. In this role, you will transition our traditional, manual change review boards into a modern, automated, and evidence-based governance model.

By embedding security and compliance directly into our automated software pipelines, you will play a central role in ensuring that the technology powering the region is deployed faster, safer, and with unprecedented stability.

As an IT Specialist (Change Authorization & Delivery Lead), you will: Serve as the final authority on system-wide software updates, steering the approval process away from tedious, manual checklist meetings. You will empower teams to focus instead on automated, high-speed validation of code readiness, ensuring every update is justified and safe.

Embed automated security checks, vulnerability scans, and regulatory compliance protocols directly into the software development pipeline. You will shift quality assurance from a final-stage bottleneck into a continuous, automated process that runs seamlessly in the background.

Champion and design low-risk, pre-approved deployment pathways for mature applications. By creating highly automated and reliable pipelines, you will enable teams to rapidly roll out new features and security patches without compromising system stability.

Establish and track modern development metrics-such as deployment frequency, change success rates, and recovery times. You will analyze these data trends to uncover bottlenecks, reduce risks, and make strategic, evidence-based recommendations to executive leadership.

Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate modern project tracking systems (like ServiceNow) directly with automated cloud deployment pipelines (like Azure DevOps). Your goal is to eliminate manual paperwork by automatically generating and filing compliance records as code moves to production.

Design and maintain clear, accessible visual dashboards. These will provide developers, engineers, and executive leaders with instant, real-time insights into upcoming software changes, pipeline health, and overall system performance. Act as the central coordinator and communication hub during major scheduled system updates.

You will align software development and infrastructure teams, ensuring everyone is prepared with robust contingency and rollback plans for a smooth launch. Take the lead during critical outages or software emergencies.

You will coordinate technical teams to deploy emergency patches rapidly, ensuring the system returns to normal operations quickly while still maintaining essential safety controls.

About Product
VyOS is an open-source network operating system that provides an all-in-one platform for network management. Built on Linux, VyOS integrates powerful routing, firewall, VPN, and network services into a unified system. Unlike traditional networking hardware, VyOS can be deployed on a wide range of platforms, from physical routers and cloud environments to virtual machines, giving users flexibility and control over their network infrastructure.
The key strength of VyOS lies in its comprehensive feature set. It supports dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, RIP), multiple VPN types (IPsec, OpenVPN, WireGuard), firewall rules, traffic shaping, and more - all configured through a unified command-line interface (CLI) familiar to network engineers. Its ability to scale across various environments makes it popular with organizations seeking open-source networking solutions.
Job description
The Network Support Engineer is responsible for developing, validating, and optimizing VyOS networking solutions to ensure performance, stability, and usability. This role involves designing Proof of Concept (PoC) scenarios, testing new features, troubleshooting complex issues, and maintaining technical documentation. The Network Engineer will work closely with developers, support teams, and external partners to enhance VyOS compatibility and functionality across diverse network environments.

Diagnose and resolve network performance, security, and connectivity issues, utilizing advanced debugging and analysis tools.
Investigate escalated technical issues, conduct root cause analysis, and deliver reproducible solutions or detailed technical reports for development resolution.
Conduct functional, performance, and regression testing for VyOS features and fixes, creating and maintaining detailed test documentation.
Develop and manage automated test frameworks for repetitive test cases, enhancing testing accuracy and efficiency.
Enhance testing methodologies by introducing advanced tools and frameworks to optimize validation processes and outcomes.
Conduct interoperability testing with third-party systems to ensure seamless integration of VyOS into diverse networking environments.
Maintain a centralized knowledge base with detailed, technically accurate articles and solution documentation to support internal and external stakeholders.

The IT PM provides hands-on technical and functional support, resolves complex platform issues, manages enhancements, supports reporting and data integrity, and enables partner organizations through implementation services.

Major responsibilities include LMS platform governance, lifecycle management, troubleshooting, capability planning, catalog design, administrative role structure, and long-term scalability.

The position supports systems integration, data architecture, migrations, authentication troubleshooting, and validation of data feeds between the LMS and external systems.

The IT PM also serves as COR for learning technology contracts, supports acquisition and vendor management, enables partner programs, leads go-live activities, and manages commercial content integrations such as LinkedIn Learning, Coursera, and Skillsoft.
All qualification and time-in-grade (if applicable) requirements must be met within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.

You must meet the minimum qualification requirements as stated in the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Operating Manual, Qualification Standards for General Schedule Positions, http://www.opm.gov/qualifications/Standards/group-stds/gs-prof.asp.

Basic Requirement: Applicants must have IT-related experience demonstrating the following competencies appropriate to, or above, the level of this position. For vacancies below the full-performance level of the position, the basic requirement will be evaluated on a developmental basis.

Your resume and work experience should clearly support your ability to meet these competencies and will be evaluated as part of the entire application process.

Attention to Detail- experience reviewing my own information technology-related work or data and have been asked by others to review their work or data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency with standards.

Customer Service- experience maintaining relationships with customers, assessing current information technology needs of customers, and developing or identifying information technology products and services that are tailored to meet customer needs.

Oral Communication- briefing mid-level management and IT staff on the status of information technology systems, projects, or daily operations, including the communication of technical information to a non-technical audience.

Problem Solving- identifying alternatives to address complex information technology-related issues by gathering and applying information from a variety of sources that provide a number of potential solutions.

In addition to meeting the basic requirement, you must have one year specialized experience.NH-03: One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-11 or equivalent, in other personnel pay systems.

Specialized experience as follows: Experience in LMS configuration and integrations with external systems, including Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS), workforce data feeds, commercial learning content providers, authentication platforms, and partner systems.

Experience in acquisition planning, contract administration, and vendor management activities for LMS technologies, commercial learning content, software licensing agreements, and related service support contracts.

Experience with technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to conduct system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), production readiness reviews, and data validation activities.

Experience data migration projects by developing and executing test scenarios, validating migrated records, documenting findings, collecting end-user feedback, and assisting with implementation and cut-over activities to ensure successful transition to production environments.

NH-04: One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-13 or equivalent, in other personnel pay systems.

Specialized experience as follows: Managing, configuring, sustaining, and optimizing enterprise Learning Management Systems, including Cornerstone OnDemand or similar cloud-based LMS platforms, to support large-scale learner populations, administrative workflows, catalog structures, content delivery, reporting, and long-term platform scalability.

Monitoring, testing, troubleshooting, and validating integrations between learning platforms and external systems, including HR systems, workforce data feeds, authentication services, commercial content providers, and partner systems, with responsibility for resolving data errors, failed feeds, reporting discrepancies, and access issues.

Leading technical planning and execution for learning technology initiatives, including system enhancements, data migrations, user acceptance testing, pilot deployments, phased rollouts, production cutover, sustainment planning, and coordination with stakeholders to translate business requirements into system configurations and implementation plans.

Supporting acquisition and contract management activities for learning technology products and services, including serving as or supporting a Contracting Officer's Representative, conducting market research, developing technical requirements, reviewing vendor solutions, evaluating performance, and assessing cost, schedule, scope, licensing, and service delivery impacts.

PART-TIME OR UNPAID EXPERIENCE: Credit will be given for appropriate unpaid and or part-time work. You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

VOLUNTEER WORK EXPERIENCE: Refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service Programs (i.e., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student and social).

Our impact: guaranteeing the right product in the right place at the right time for our stores, warehouses, and marketplaces worldwide. Our challenges: accelerating the group's digital transformation, integrating new business models (circular economy, wholesale), and preparing the transition to SAP S/4HANA.

As a Support Engineer (f/m/d) , you will ensure the stability, efficiency, and evolution of our order and stock orchestration tools. Your core responsibilities include:
Run Management & User Commitments: Organize daily ticket resolution, ensure service level agreements (stock accuracy KPIs, dispatch timing), and provide dedicated support during peak commercial periods.
Incident Resolution & Continuous Improvement: Perform root cause analysis, enhance monitoring tools (dashboards, control towers), and automate recurring tasks leveraging tech and AI.
Transformation Projects & SAP: Challenge upcoming product features with the project team, drive updates on our SAP ECC module (SD/MM), and help prepare the S/4HANA migration planned for 2028.
Communication & On-Call Rotations: Maintain transparent communication with stakeholders during incidents or maintenance, and participate in on-call rotations for critical operations.

Education & Background: Engineering degree (preferably in Computer Science) or equivalent experience.
Functional & Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of supply chain processes combined with proven experience on SAP modules (SD and MM).
Automation Mindset: Passion for eliminating manual repetitive tasks, tracking data performance, and integrating AI into daily operations.
Soft Skills: Team player spirit ("Play Collective"), clear communication, strong prioritization skills, and collaborative leadership.
Languages: Fluent English is mandatory (daily international scope).

ERP / Systems: SAP ECC (SD & MM modules), S/4HANA roadmap.
Monitoring & Data: Operational control towers, ticketing systems, and custom monitoring dashboards.

s.h: OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION AND ACCESSIBILITY
s.t:

What if technology allowed us to push the boundaries and take sports experiences to new levels? That's exactly our goal at Decathlon Digital! Together, we are creating the largest digital sports platform, leveraging tech innovation from design to value chain optimization, connected experiences and product second life.
Changing the game for good . We are in this for the love of sports. And like everything we love, we want it to last. That’s why we are embarking on a journey to create a more sustainable tech model, reducing our direct environmental impact while maintaining a safe, diverse, and inclusive space for all our people to learn and thrive together. Team up with us to design the digital future of sports.
